name: Tech Deep-Dive & Startup Architecture
description: Architectural blueprint and technical teardown aesthetic. Clean drafting paper textures, technical cyan accents, blueprint frames, system architecture diagrams, and high-precision metrics.
aiImagePromptPrefix: High-density technical blueprint illustration on light blueprint wash (#f4f7fb), slate ink (#0f172a), cobalt blue (#2563eb) and cyan (#0891b2) schematic accents, precise vector lineart, modular layout:

character.treatment: Vector blueprint isometric avatar with status tags

antiSlopRules: Highlight technical bottlenecks, tradeoffs, and failure modes
Quantify engineering specs in concrete units (ms, GB, IOPS)

stylingTips.pacing: Target 140–150 WPM. Snappy, technical, modular flow. Average beat length 6–9 seconds.
stylingTips.exhibits: Product UI blueprints, code architecture snippets, server schematics, vector diagrams, and product tear-downs with 'blueprint' or 'editorial-card' styling.
stylingTips.annotations: Loupe/zoom magnifiers for code or UI details, vector callout lines, technical status tags ('V1.0', 'API', 'LATENCY').
stylingTips.dataGraphics: Benchmark comparisons, throughput line curves, speedup ratios (3.2x), latency counters in milliseconds.
stylingTips.antiSlopRules: Focus on engineering constraints, trade-offs, and protocol mechanics rather than hype or marketing claims.
